# Nexify Webworks - Web Engineering & Design Studio

> Nexify Webworks is a freelance web development and UI/UX design studio offering custom React and Next.js applications, custom WordPress website design in Elementor & ACF, custom Gutenberg block theme development, Figma UI/UX prototyping, and Google Core Web Vitals SEO optimization.

## Primary Services

- [Website Development using React & Next.js](https://nexifywebworks.in/services/react-development): High-performance Next.js App Router applications, SSG/SSR pre-rendering, Tailwind CSS v4, and sub-second Core Web Vitals speed.
- [Website Design in WordPress (Elementor & ACF)](https://nexifywebworks.in/services/wordpress-elementor-acf): Custom WordPress website design powered by Elementor Pro and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF Pro) for flexible client content management.
- [Custom WordPress Block Theme Development](https://nexifywebworks.in/services/wordpress-custom-block-theme): Bespoke Gutenberg block themes built with Full Site Editing (FSE), custom block patterns, theme.json design tokens, and zero page builder bloat.
- [Figma UI/UX Design & Prototyping](https://nexifywebworks.in/services/ui-ux-design): User-centric wireframes, design systems, and clickable interactive prototypes built in Figma for 1:1 developer code handoff.
- [SEO & Core Web Vitals Optimization](https://nexifywebworks.in/services/seo-optimization): Technical SEO audits, Google search crawl optimization, LCP/INP/CLS speed tuning, and JSON-LD structured data schema injection.

## Technical Architecture & SEO Specifications

- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion)
- **SEO Standards:** Semantic HTML5 DOM, JSON-LD Schema Graphs (Organization, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList), XML Sitemaps, Robots.txt, OpenGraph & Twitter Cards
- **Performance Target:** Green Core Web Vitals scores across Mobile and Desktop
